Act 2023 does not authorise a constable to retain confidential journalistic material. If confidential
journalistic material is seized during a search conducted under such an order, a constable may
apply to a Circuit Judge as soon as reasonably practicable after the material is seized for the
issue of a warrant authorising the retention of the confidential journalistic material. A warrant
issued by the court may impose conditions on the retention and use of the material. See note
7HA.
